records.description: You keep putting one foot in front of the other. Your steady effort can help a team through a difficult day.
You make room for other people and their ideas. That willingness to listen can turn strangers into companions.
You are willing to act when something matters. Courage can mean taking a step even while you feel afraid.
You bring a little brightness wherever you go. Shared laughter can make a long journey feel shorter.
You notice opportunities for a little mischief. Your lively ideas can keep your friends guessing.
You find delight in small and unexpected things. That open curiosity gives familiar places a fresh look.
You notice danger and take your feelings seriously. A trusted companion can help you find the next safe step.
When an idea catches you, you want to get moving. Your energy can help a team make its first move.
You have your own point of view and aren't quick to hide it. Speaking honestly can be a gift when you also listen.
You value a little breathing room. Your quiet presence can help others gather their thoughts.
You are comfortable letting the day unfold. Your unhurried pace can remind a busy team to rest.
Connection matters to you. A familiar voice and a shared journey can mean more than a grand destination.
You don't always follow the expected path. An unusual idea may help your team notice something everyone else missed.
Naughty, energetic, and always ready for a treat! You love a muddy adventure, a game with friends, and blueberries, chicken, and bananas. Roux shares your playful spirit.
